title: About Detroit House Poster Repair
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 333 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Buying a $500 House in Detroit: bidding on the soul of my city and Largest Abandoned Factory in the World: The Packard Factory, Detroit - Sometimes Interesting, plus 7 more. A source image from i.guim.co.uk helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Detroit House Poster Repair: Weathered Detroit civic-repair poster wall, torn-wall camera grammar: a heavy asymmetrical mound of nested crosshatched house polygons tips from lower left toward upper center, backed by a rust-orange cart crescent. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central crosshatched house pile, rust-orange crescent hull lip, and lower-left torn paper and weed edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
